translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Kamok Bailet Yesus dákadálawsa sung uta ko.
Kale kutim bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so sawa kukumin so gebom gebom so kansol adikum so iyo dek amki nadiwe weng gudula dau nadiwe Yesus ayo sok gei dau nadiwade dew yak Bailet daudawiwe,
Bailet ayo Yesus dákadálaw, “kaba, Yu kayak Kamokime?” Akane, aka bako nadale, “au bakabaw, be ki ka.” Akeisa ko.
Kale bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim iyo weng seng kuw falak teida bom kei bidiwe,
alo Bailet ayo asiki bakodaw, “kaba imi kin wala suduwo. Kale tad falak teikamubiw, bo kam weng mak yán kiyamokabaw bade báye?” Aka.
Kata Yesus ayo Bailet weng bakaba weng atung mak fakadu bakodawongin banim keidane, gawman kamok ayo beso kuwo aksa ko.
Kale bela ilim kanamin kukuw kanamáliwo, kale ban imin wanin tem ka. Kale som abiw kasel ilita ki bakodaw kanodin kinim sok gei dawtisaw, beta talá dabadáyo, kale sidiw talá dabadá dabadá keimino,
kale kinim mak win Badábas ayo alaso Udom gawman kudongin kus gawman ew moyam ilik ilok kei bom kinim ábom kei badano kalabus dawtisiw.
Kale kinim iyo tada tada au nadiwade Bailet dákadálaw, “nulum kanayamábaw tawo.” Akiwe,
Aka bakoyam, “kim aket ayo Yu kayak kamokim ata talá dauyamone?” Yakeisa.
Be watawo kaleyo bá, Bailet ayo kal keidomane, wanang kinim ika bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim ilim yán abodongin dako Yesus am yán ki abodiw ka. Kalom bumi kalan dew tadiw ka, kale nadano ko.
Kale bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim iyo kinim aket dafáyam bom nadiwade Bailet bakodaw, “Badábas ata min talá dauyam nadawe Yesus ata dabadálalo!” Akan tabiwe,
Bailet ayo kinim gu du mobiw bakoyam, “kim aket mew Yu kayak Kamokim be yaknodawako, kale dew nam tadbiwe?”
Kalane, wanang kinim iyo weng kala bakodaw, “anak as dim dádino!” Kaliwe,
Bailet aka dákadála, “watawo kaleyo? Mafak so mak keiseyo kanam kalbiwe? Kalane, ika kitid weng kuw bako nadiwade, “anak as dim dádino!” Kalsiw.

Kale Bailet ayo kinim wanang imi aket kalfalin dauyamono. Kale nadale Badábas ata min talá dauyam bá kuw, Yesus ata un tabudin dauyama malang tuw faum si dau dew yak anak as dim dádino, kale dauyamsa.
Kale gawman kin mobe alam un tabudin iyo Yesus dew tam Bailet alam am abiw dal nadiwade kanomin un tabudin kinim iyo tada tada falala dau nadiwade
ika kamok ilim mak kudu mikidaw nadiwade baing manil fakám si dau nadiwade manil uyo kudew yak gebom dim kutidaw nadiwade
bakada bom akaniw ko. “Au, Yu kayak Kamokim!” Ak bom nadiwade
asawil asawil kafulok kuek gebom dakáda bom nadiwade kasuk fadet yak sanlaw bom nadiwade beta kasen kei katun katun fakela suksuklawuw kaí, ak bom keimsiw.
Kale ika atafimin be banimane, kamokim ilim mikidawiw ayo falkan keidaw nadiwade alo alam ilim mikidaw nadiwade beta dew yak anak as dim dádumo, kale dew uniw ko.
Yesus aneyak as dim dásiw sung uta ko.

Kale Yesus ayo daw tam mo unom nadiwade kinim mak leiw akayam unono kanaba ami win ayo Saimon aka Saidin bakan kalo tada. Kale un tabudin kinim iyo eidaw fotabiw, Yesus ami as dawing dákamin uyo kudawiw kudewa unsiw. Kale Saimon be Aleksanda so Adufas so imi alawo kale,
Yesus ayo daw tam modiw ki tad bi tad anang mukkun win Golgáta kalbiw, kal tasiw. Kale Golgáta kalbiw be kinim gebom kun taw, kalanaliw.
Kale ika kal wain wok mafak mafak kuok tabin kuok tabin win mad so bake wan dakelin wok ayo Yesus daudawiw, wanako, akei kudawiw. Kata aka kudu wanongin dakodane,
Yesus ayo anak as dim dá nadiwade ami ilim kal uyo faku kudu kuti nadiwade sung ginan bom kan ata win keida ka, kale kudula kudulasiw ko.
Kale Yesus anak as dim dásiw ayo ki kutim atan sinik tada bati dim tadano, kanodawsiw.
Kale alam gebom dimo be fut mak godu beta mafak keidano, kanodawuwo kalin weng godusiw, be YESUS YU KAYAK KAMOKIM. Kale godusiw ko.
Kanabisiw be yakot wanin kinim alew mak Yesus wol bake inak as dim dásiw. Kale mak be Yesus alam teng miskuno kal, mak be alam awáno kal kanoyamsiw.
Kale be Got alam godin weng uyo bako, “wanang kinim im aket fukanin bo akal ban keimin kinimo, akokabiwo.” Kalesu.

Kale wanang kinim iyo leiw tadene bom nadiwe weng kufo weng mafak bakadaw bom nadiwe gebom budu budu bom nadiwade bakodiw, “kaba bako nadaw, ‘Yu kayak Yol am uyo dakel ku nadine asiki am alewbino kuw kei kufo ginedomino.’ Kalesaw.
Kale kamano ki katamuwo as dim kudá tá fák madák abalo!” Ak bidiwe,

alo weng alataw be ki bokal kayak as fakiw dakádawin kinim so sawa kukumin kinim so gebom gebom so iyo atafi bom nadiwade bakodawa bakodawa bom nadiwade bakodiw, “aka yak madik ita kail bá takeikuyamába, kata alami uta asiki kail bá takeikudoma banim.” Kal bom nadiwe alo bako,

“kala Got Walusa Kinim, Isadael kamok kale dabadáliwo as dim kudá fák madák abe unano, nuka atin afan Got ami Kinime kalumo.” Kal bom kei bidiwade kinim alew inak alasino wol bake as dim sil biki imubiw iyo ilisino dokansiw.
Yesus fikalesa sung uta ko.
Kale atanim gubidim bikidane, midilukin tadu adikum bakan ayo midila muma di bada bi atan sinik tadelak alewbinon dim kal banimsa.
Kale atan sinik tadelak alewbino dim keidune, Yesus aka weng dukum kuw bako, “Elowai Elowai lama sabaktanai.” Kalesa. Kale umi mit uyo ki, “nalam Got, nalam Got, watawo ibik dunabáwe?” Kalesa ko.
Kale kal bom keimane, kinim madik tod bidiw iyo kalin weng be kidi nadiwade ika bakodiw, “aka Ilaitsa gánlabano.” Kalaniwe,

bude wabising kinim mak aka aik yak abum mak takadu kudew tad nadale kudew dák wok wain winega kalbiw, kudaka bi nadale kutow as gang tem tade nadale kufo kudew tam Yesus dádawi wanako. Kalanom nadale bakoda, “sading kaliwo, nuka atam aluwo, Ilaitsa so mak madák dakodaw as dawing dákamin dim kal takadu dabadála madák abomane kaleyono.” Kalanane,
Yesus ayo weng dukum kuw bako, “kolo” kalbane fikale kei badane,
Yol am awsom lim kal leiw atimin uyo tam kaw tam abe kikiw kuw gadát taden bidák dakat kalon kaú yak aba maek aba ausa.
Kale un tabudin kinim kin modin mak Yesus as dawing dá anbidiw kal tod alom nadano Yesus ayo kano fikala ka. Kale nadano aka bako, “atin afan kinim bela Got Man tudun be.” Kalesa.
Kale wanang madik mak un bi sikam kaekal tod bom nadiwade kin mobisiw. Imi iw tem kadák ayo ki Madiya Makdala keidu Yemis so Yosew so imi akun Madiya keidu, wáw Salome keidu,
ita Yesus ayo Galili kal ami ibik tein ká bom nadiwo kal kin modaw bom dakádawsiw. Be ita kuw bá, wanang seng madik iliso Yedusalemo tasiw iyo iliso tod fakadábisiw ko.
Kale kamane am dánbu uyo imin ufek ufek mikil kei bi sin matam kawák uyo Finuyámin am dánámin,

kayo bude Yosew Adamatiya kayak ayo tase. Kale aka win tabin kinim kansol kale, aka Got ami kasák gu taduko, kale leiw fenábano. Kale aka atud kuw fakadá fok tam Bailet bakodaw, “naka Yesus ami atukul bo nata kuwádono kale tadi ko.” Akane,
Bailet aket madiw keidaw, “aye Yesus be fikala memak tei.” Kalesa. Kale nadale un tabudin kinim mak gán dádawa tadane, dákadálaw, “Yesus ayo afan fikalebane?” Akane,
beta un tabudin kinim ayo Yesus ami fikala sung uyo afan bakoda kidi nadale Bailet ayo Yosew bakodaw, “au, yak atukul uyo kuwádawalo!” Akane,

Beta Yosew ayo ilim kál linen mak mo kudew tad nadale atukul uyo ilim fal fal dau nadale dew dák tum tem alokso kado mikil kei dabadása kal dau nadale tum dukum mak eí fakámam kudew maek tum tem yal ati kudálane,
Madiya Makdala so Madiya Yosew akun so ita Yesus dauda imal mewso kal Yesus atukul uyo kin mobisiw ko.
